system.description:
Resembling humanoid dragons, Draken are relatives of the terrifying dragons of legend. Their scales come in a variety of brilliant colors, their maws house fanged teeth that often serve as a serrated clamp, and their fingers resemble the talonlike claws of dragons.


Breath Attack: You have a Breath Attack that requires an Action to begin. On a subsequent Turn within the same Scene, you can then use an Action or skip your Move to exhale a 15’ Cone of energy that deals 2d6!, using an Endure or Will Save for the Check.


Scale: You have a +1 bonus to Armor.


Draconic Resilience: You take half damage from a source of your choice from either Acid, Cold, Fire, or Shock.
